title: types.odin claims pre-4.2 event streams stay byte-identical; serialize.odin in the same diff admits they do not
detail: Direct contradiction inside the diff: one comment promises byte-identity for pre-4.2 streams, the other states pre-4.2 drop streams are NOT byte-identical (+4B target). Re-bless decisions ride on these comments; one is false.
recommended_fix: Amend the Event comment to exclude Packet_Dropped from the byte-identity list, mirroring serialize.odin's wording.

title: Byte-layout test's failure message says 'want 30' but its own size expression evaluates to 38
evidence:
testing.expectf(t, len(want) == 2*(2+1+4)+2*(1+1+2+4+4),
	"4.2 payload sizes: got %d, want 30", len(want))
detail: 2*(2+1+4)+2*(1+1+2+4+4) = 38, but the diagnostic hardcodes "want 30". On failure the message misreports the expected size and misleads the next debugger.
recommended_fix: Change the message to "want 38" or interpolate the computed expression instead of a hardcoded number.
